instruction.name: ext.w.b
instruction.description: Sign-extend the low 8-bit byte to 64 bits.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: ext.w.b $r12, $r4; ext.w.b $r13, $r5; ext.w.b $r14, $r6; ext.w.b $r15, $r7; ext.w.b $r16, $r8; ext.w.b $r17, $r9; ext.w.b $r18, $r10; ext.w.b $r19, $r11
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8
